**Job Description**
 We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
   

  

 As a Senior Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Connected Commerce, Travel division, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Designs and implements complex features and services within owned domains; collaborates with upstream/downstream teams to deliver end\-to\-end solutions; contributes to API contracts, versioning, and backward compatibility.
* Contributes to production readiness and operational excellence by helping define/meet SLOs/SLIs, improving observability (logs, metrics, traces), participating in incident response and post\-incident reviews, and delivering durable fixes and runbooks to reduce repeat issues.
* Applies secure\-by\-default and resilient design patterns in day\-to\-day development (timeouts, retries with exponential backoff/jitter, circuit breakers, bulkheads, idempotency, graceful degradation).
* Authors design proposals and participates in design reviews; partners with Architecture and peer teams to align designs and reduce integration risk.
* Writes secure, concise, high\-quality production code and reviews/debugs code across backend and frontend as needed.
* Engages in pair programming, rigorous code reviews, and reliable estimation; builds user\-facing experiences that meet established performance and accessibility standards.
* Applies database rigor across SQL/NoSQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning, and caching to improve latency and throughput.
* Integrates firm\-approved, privacy\-safe AI assistants into development workflows to accelerate test generation, documentation, refactoring, and static analysis triage—with human\-in\-the\-loop review and CI quality gates.

**About the Company** 




  





  





 Halo X Labs is building HALO Chip, a subdermal GPS and health\-tracking implant for dogs. We're early\-stage and currently raising, building out our founding technical team.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 We're looking for a Founding AI/ML Engineer to own the training and development of the two AI models that run directly on our device: a motion classifier for dead\-reckoning location tracking, and a health classifier for fever and heatstroke detection. You'll work closely with our Head of Development, who owns AI strategy and firmware integration, while you own the hands\-on model work: data, training, and getting these models small and accurate enough to run on a constrained, ultra\-low\-power microcontroller.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Training data pipeline for both models, working with labeled sensor logs from bench and live\-animal testing
* Motion classifier development: gait and activity classification from motion sensor data
* Health classifier development: fever and heatstroke detection from temperature and activity data
* Model training, quantization, and compilation using Edge Impulse, targeting deployment on TensorFlow Lite Micro
* Working directly with our Head of Development to integrate trained models into firmware and validate them against real power and memory budgets



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Real experience training and deploying models for constrained hardware, TinyML / embedded ML, not just cloud\-scale ML
* Comfortable working with real\-world sensor data (motion, temperature) rather than clean benchmark datasets

* A startup\-stage mindset: this role exists before there's much training data yet, you'll help define how it gets collected and structured, not just consume it
* Comfortable working directly with a non\-technical CEO and a small founding team



  





  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





  





 This is a founding, equity\-only role equity in Halo X Labs. We are currently raising, and salary will begin shortly after you join, once funding closes.
